summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of AI KARAU Meeting Portal completed. All backend APIs (16/16 tests) passed. Frontend UI fully functional including guest join flow, video controls, chat, AI backgrounds, view modes, and mobile responsiveness. WebSocket connection shows intermittent instability (1006 disconnect codes) with automatic reconnection working.

minor.issue: WebSocket connections frequently close with code 1006 (abnormal closure), requiring automatic reconnection. Reconnection logic works but creates flaky user experience.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple WebSocket disconnects (1006 code) observed during meeting session. Auto-reconnect works but may cause brief state sync issues.

issues: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent accessibility - console warning shown

action_items: Investigate WebSocket 1006 disconnect causes - may be related to proxy/load balancer timeout settings or heartbeat interval
Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components to fix accessibility warning
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingRoom.jsx is well-structured with decoupled media/API initialization - good design
WebSocket reconnection logic with exponential backoff is properly implemented
ICE server configuration correctly includes STUN servers from Google
Virtual background implementation uses MediaPipe AI with fallback support
Guest join flow properly creates temporary user IDs and allows meeting access without login

success_rate.frontend: 95% - All UI features working, WebSocket stability is the only concern

seed_data_creation: None required - used existing meeting DAF3BD00
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI KARAU Meeting Portal is fully functional. Key test meeting: DAF3BD00. All video controls (mute, camera, screen share, hand raise) work. Chat, AI Notes, Background selector panels work. Gallery and Focus view modes work. Mobile responsive design works with bottom sheet panels. WebSocket has occasional disconnects but auto-reconnects successfully. Google/Apple OAuth are MOCKED.
